en.headline: Saltwater pipe bursts on Yau Tong Ko Chiu Road, spraying water three metres high
en.dek: A saltwater pipe ruptured near the community hall around 6pm, sending a fountain of water and debris onto the pavement and disrupting traffic until staff closed the valve.
body: A saltwater pipe burst on Ko Chiu Road in Yau Tong opposite the community hall at about 6pm on Sunday, sending a column of water up to three metres high and scattering sand and stones across the pavement, according to reports.

Police closed off the area after passers-by raised the alarm. The Water Supplies Department was contacted and staff arrived to shut the valve and begin repairs. The incident affected traffic in the vicinity.
Preliminary indications were that the pipe carried saltwater used for flushing. No injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 油塘高超道煙水管爆裂 水柱高達三米
zh.dek: 晚上約6時油塘高超道社區會堂對出煙水管爆裂，水花四溅高達三米，路面滿佈沙石，水務署人員到場關斷水擁槍修。
body: 星期日晚上約6時，油塘高超道近社區會堂對出一條煙水管爆裂，水柱高達約3米，水花四溅並帶出沙石滿佈行人路面。
途人發現後報警，警方到場封鎖事發位置。水務署人員隨即趕到，關上水擁並開始槍修。事故一度影響附近交通。
初步了解涉事為煙水供水管。暫未有傷亡報告。
